name: integer_exceeds_int64_max
description: An integer one past the int64 maximum (2^63 = 9223372036854775808) is out of the canonical numeric domain and MUST be rejected on decode, not silently approximated to a double. SPEC Section 2.3.2: values outside [-2^63, 2^63-1] are modeled as strings; a bare numeric literal beyond the domain is an error. A pre-errata decoder that floats the literal accepts it silently, so this fixture fails red against unfixed code.
